column2: RECOMMENDATION • A minimum of 25 grams of vegetable oils should be used daily to ensure an adequate alpha-linolenic acid intake*. • The use of butter and tropical oils should be limited, and preference should be given to vegetable oil based spreads with at least 60% fat and high in unsaturated fatty acids. *  An adult with an average daily energy intake of 10 MJ should get at least 1.3 grams of  alpha-linolenic  acid  per  day.  Alpha-linolenic  acid  is  present  in  rapeseed,  linseed, camelina, soya, hemp seed, wheat germ and walnut oils.
